providerMode: None. The c3cmp lab has AI disabled and no stand-in; the compare and archived-pair parts make no AI call.
browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, one context per identity at 1440x1000 CSS px

setup.text: administrator API: Contract C-41 with a download-only primary placeholder and four supporting Documents: Word v1 thirty/monthly, v2 sixty/quarterly, v3 ninety/annually; PDF v1 / Word v2; TXT v1 / PDF v2; malformed PDF v1 / PDF v2.

legal_team_member API: Contract C-42 with a download-only primary placeholder and four supporting Documents: Word v1 thirty/monthly, v2 sixty/quarterly, v3 ninety/annually; PDF v1 / Word v2; TXT v1 / PDF v2; malformed PDF v1 / PDF v2.
administrator API: Contract C-43 with a placeholder primary and a two-Version Word Document that has never been compared.
legal_team_member API: Contract C-44 with a placeholder primary and a two-Version Word Document that has never been compared.

steps.step: Choose the Versions: Compare with previous, Preparing comparison, then Changes
steps.expected: Compare with previous opens the pair v2 → v3; while processing is held the page says Preparing comparison and updates to Changes when ready; no Document Version is added.
steps.actual: Version actions for version 2 also offered Compare with previous and opened "v1 → v2". Documents -> Actions for doc029-terms-admin.docx -> Compare with previous opened "v2 → v3". With this lab's worker paused the page read "Preparing comparison Comparing both versions. This page will update when it is ready."; after resuming it changed to the Changes view without a reload. The chain still has 3 Versions.

steps.step: Pair control, change list, Previous change and Next change
steps.expected: Choosing Older and Newer opens each pair at once; the choices keep the older before the newer; insertions and deletions describe the newer Version; Previous/Next move through changes.
steps.actual: Older v1 opened v1 → v3 at once; Newer offered ["v2","v3"] and v2 opened v1 → v2. With v1 → v2, Older offered ["v1"]. Changes: ["¶2, Replaced = ¶2thirty → sixty","¶3, Replaced = ¶3monthly → quarterly"]. Compared text: "doc029-terms-admin.docx → doc029-terms-admin.docx DOC-032 compat compat-c fictional payment terms. Payment is due within Inserted: sixty Deleted: thirty days. Invoices are issued Inserted: quarterly Deleted: monthly.". Next change moved the current change 0 -> 1; Previous change moved it back to 0.

steps.step: The Document reader offers Compare with the change count
steps.expected: When a ready Comparison exists for the previous pair, the reader link shows its change count and opens that Comparison.
steps.actual: Reader panel "doc029-terms-admin.docx, version 3" showed the link "Compare with the previous version, 2 changes"; it opened "v2 → v3" in the Changes view.

steps.step: Export a Word Comparison as a Generated redline
steps.expected: Export track changes appends a Generated redline Version that records both operands; Open redline opens it; the file carries tracked changes; exporting again reuses it; reopening adds nothing; Generated redlines are not operands.
steps.actual: On v1 → v2, Export track changes became Open redline. Version 4 is "generated_redline" compared from v1 to v2; its download (sha256 24fb3da5ae8d…) has w:ins ["sixty","quarterly"] and w:del ["thirty","monthly"]. Open redline opened "doc029-terms-admin.docx, version 4". Exporting the same pair again answered 200 with Version 4; reopening v1 → v2 showed Open redline; Newer offered ["v2","v3"]; a request naming Version 4 as an operand answered 400. The chain has 4 Versions and v1-v3 remain.

steps.step: A text Comparison (PDF against Word)
steps.expected: The page says it was built from extracted text, shows the wording change, shows Export needs two Word files. and cannot be exported.
steps.actual: PDF v1 → Word v2 showed the extracted-text notice and "Export needs two Word files." with no export control. Compared text: "doc029-mixed-admin.pdf → doc029-mixed-admin.docx This comparison was built from extracted text, so formatting is not shown. DOC-032 compat compat-c fictional payment terms. Payment is due within Delet". A direct export answered 409; the chain still has 2 Versions.

steps.step: If the Comparison fails: reason, Download links, no retry, corrected new Version
steps.expected: A TXT operand and a failed PDF extraction each fail with a reason and Download links; reopening returns the same failure with no retry; a corrected new Version compares as No changes although its bytes differ.
steps.actual: TXT v1 → PDF v2 read "Comparison failed" with "Version 1 does not support extracted text." and ["Download doc029-plain-admin.txt","Download doc029-plain-admin.pdf"]; both downloads matched the uploaded bytes. Reloading /documents/01a0e6e0-1d66-78d4-b4e3-a7c243bfee4f/compare?from=01a0e6e0-1d66-78d4-b4e3-a7c3dd617228&to=01a0e6e0-1d7b-7d20-a07b-580225d55f89 returned the same failed Comparison (id unchanged) with no retry control. After adding a corrected PDF as Version 3 (setup, different sha256), Compare with previous opened "v2 → v3" and read "No changes". Malformed PDF v1 → PDF v2 read "Version 1 text extraction failed." with 2 Download links.

steps.step: Archiving keeps Comparisons readable and blocks new Generated redlines until restored
steps.expected: With the Document archived, Changes stay readable and no export is offered or accepted. With the owning Contract archived, the export is refused. After both are restored, the v2 → v3 export appends a Generated redline.
steps.actual: Documents -> Actions -> Archive on doc029-terms-admin.docx: v2 → v3 still showed Changes with no export control, and a direct export answered 409. Document restored (API). Contract actions -> Archive on C-41: Changes stayed readable; the control showed "This contract is archived. Restore it before changing its paper."; a direct export answered 409; still 4 Versions. After Restore, Export track changes on v2 → v3 appended Version 5 (generated_redline, v2 -> v3; w:ins ["ninety","annually"], w:del ["sixty","quarterly"]).

steps.step: Close comparison returns to the owning record
steps.expected: Close comparison opens the owning Contract's Documents section.
steps.actual: Close comparison opened /contracts/41/documents, where doc029-terms-admin.docx and its Actions menu are listed.

steps.step: Only Administrators and Legal Team Members open Comparisons
steps.expected: A Business User on the Contract team cannot open the Comparison page or request, read or export a Comparison.
steps.actual: Jonas Weber (Business User; team add answered 201) opening the v1 → v2 Comparison URL landed on "/portal" with no Changes view; requesting the pair answered 403; exporting answered 403.

steps.expected: On an archived Document, Compare with previous for a pair that was never compared opens a Comparison that reaches Changes, offers no export, and adds no Version.
steps.actual: Documents -> Actions -> Archive on doc029-archived-admin.docx; with Show archived on, its Actions still offered ["Compare with previous","Restore","Delete version"]. Compare with previous opened a first-time v1 → v2 Comparison that reached Changes with no export control; the chain still has 2 Versions. The Document was restored afterwards (API).
